hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook enabling 1:1 ETH↔phiEth swaps by intercepting beforeSwap, taking input from the PoolManager, calling phiEth.deposit/withdraw for conversion, and settling the output—fully bypassing concentrated liquidity. Liquidity addition to the pool is blocked via a beforeAddLiquidity revert. Only ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee are permitted.
